issue.title: [Bug]: [Snappi] Reboot and swss reboot logic needs to be adjusted for multidut scenario

failure.body:
### Issue Description

Test Script- tests/snappi_tests/multidut/pfcwd/test_multidut_pfcwd_basic_with_snappi.py

(1)
Test case: test_pfcwd_basic_single_lossless_prio_reboot

Code:
 ```
   for duthost in dut_list:
        logger.info("Issuing a {} reboot on the dut {}".format(reboot_type, duthost.hostname))
        reboot(duthost, localhost, reboot_type=reboot_type, safe_reboot=True)
        logger.info("Wait until the system is stable")
        pytest_assert(wait_until(300, 20, 0, duthost.critical_services_fully_started),
                      "Not all critical services are fully started")
```
Issue: if the test case is being executed on single line card (single or multiple ASIC), same DUT will be rebooted twice and hence longer testcase execution.

(2)
Test case - test_pfcwd_basic_single_lossless_prio_service_restart

Code:
```
@pytest.mark.parametrize('restart_service', ['swss'])
----
    for duthost in dut_list:
        logger.info("Issuing a restart of service {} on the dut {}".format(restart_service, duthost.hostname))
        duthost.command("systemctl reset-failed {}".format(restart_service))
        duthost.command("systemctl restart {}".format(restart_service))
        logger.info("Wait until the system is stable")
        pytest_assert(wait_until(300, 20, 0, duthost.critical_services_fully_started),
                      "Not all critical services are fully started")
```

Issue:
for multi-asic environment, we do not have swss service but swss@0 and swss@1 service. With single linecard, we will end up restarting the same swss process twice.

### Results you see

=> sudo systemctl status swss
● swss.service - switch state service
     Loaded: loaded (/lib/systemd/system/swss.service; disabled; vendor preset: enabled)
     Active: inactive (dead)
=> sudo systemctl status swss@0
● <EMAIL> - switch state service
     Loaded: loaded (/lib/systemd/system/swss@.service; enabled; vendor preset: enabled)
    Drop-In: /etc/systemd/system/<EMAIL>.d
             └─auto_restart.conf
     Active: active (running) since Mon 2024-05-20 <IPV6> UTC; 2h 9min ago
 ----- curtailed output --------

### Results you expected to see

For reboot testcases:
We should add a check to see if duthost1.hostname == duthost2.hostname, and if not, then reboot both, else just do a single reboot (of either duthost1 or duthost2).

For swss restart testcases, we can find the dut<->asic mapping of the interfaces used and restart swss process based on that mapping.

### Is it platform specific

generic

resolution.title: [Snappi] - fixing swss service restart logic for basic PFCWD testcases in multi-asic environment
resolution.description:
### Description of PR
The existing PFCWD basic testcases have restart SWSS service testcases.

However, these testcases do not address the multi-asic environment.  The pull-request addresses this.

Summary:
Fixes # (issue)
The fix finds out the DUT and interfaces used in the test and based on that selects swss@0 or swss@1 to restart. The fix first verifies if the platform field exists and if yes, is set to 'broadcom-dnx' field. If this is not true, then code executes the default testcase.

### Type of change

- [X] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 202012
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [X] 202405

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
To address the multi-asic environment scenario and select appropriate SWSS depending upon the DUT-interface selected for the test.

#### How did you do it?
- Finding the DUT-interface used in the test.
- For Single line card - Single ASIC, the DUT will be same and interfaces will be from same ASIC. So only single swss is selected.
- For Single line card - Multi ASIC, DUT is same but interfaces will be from different ASIC and hence two SWSS instances are selected. Same logic for multiple line card scenario.

#### How did you verify/test it?
- Ran the test on local setup.

Logs for single line card single ASIC:
```
<IPV6> test_multidut_pfcwd_basic_with_snappi.te L0574 INFO   | Issuing a restart of service swss@0 on the dut ixre-egl-board72
<IPV6> test_multidut_pfcwd_basic_with_snappi.te L0577 INFO   | Wait until the system is stable

```

Logs for single line card multiple ASIC:
```
<IPV6> test_multidut_pfcwd_basic_with_snappi.te L0574 INFO   | Issuing a restart of service swss@1 on the dut ixre-egl-board71
<IPV6> test_multidut_pfcwd_basic_with_snappi.te L0577 INFO   | Wait until the system is stable
<IPV6> test_multidut_pfcwd_basic_with_snappi.te L0574 INFO   | Issuing a restart of service swss@0 on the dut ixre-egl-board71
<IPV6> test_multidut_pfcwd_basic_with_snappi.te L0577 INFO   | Wait until the system is stable
```
